en.t: The Tale of the Hollow Tree says:

units.source_text: 藤原俊荫随遣唐使来中国学琴，未能学成。

en.t: Fujiwara no Toshikage came to China with the Japanese envoys to Tang China to study the qin, but he was unable to master it.

units.source_text: 后又历尽艰辛，赴波斯国，向仙人学琴，始尽得其法，归去传授与日本人。

en.t: Later, after enduring many hardships, he went to Persia, studied the qin with an immortal, finally mastered its methods completely, and returned to teach them to the Japanese.
